brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Edit and adapt the first reference thumbnail into ONE new Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail for the fixed article dated 2026-11-18. Completely replace its text, player identity and pose. Output a single landscape PNG, 1792 x 1008 pixels (16:9), opaque background.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Reference 1: approved visual style only, black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B, bold Japanese typography, expressive hand-drawn ink and dry-brush strokes. Do NOT carry over Culver, the 38 points, team names, scores, date or any text from this image.
Reference 2: official profile of the real player Kerry Blackshear Jr., identity reference ONLY. Study and preserve his very short close-cropped black hair, broad forehead, substantial jaw with slightly pointed chin, defined cheekbones, thick brows, slightly hooded eyes, broad nose, full lips, closely trimmed beard along jaw and chin and fine mustache, dark brown skin and powerful tall build. Redraw entirely as a recognizably hand-inked illustration. Do not paste, trace or recreate the photo composition, uniform logos, sponsors or photograph lighting.

SUBJECT / ACTION:
One real athlete: Kerry Blackshear Jr. only. Show an energetic three-quarter waist-to-thigh portrait in the right 43% of the canvas, body twisting through a basketball pivot as he securely grips an orange basketball with both hands near the outer right hip, bent elbows, intent face turned slightly left, preparing a pass. His face should be large and recognizable, with crosshatched ink shadows and warm muted skin highlights, not a silhouette. Anatomically coherent arms and hands; one hand each on the opposite sides of the ball, natural fingers partly occluded by the ball, no extra limbs. Plain dark basketball uniform with narrow ivory trim; no text, names, numbers, logos or sponsors anywhere on uniform or ball. This is an imagined illustrative action, not a reconstruction of any actual game event. Do not add a defender or extra people.

LAYOUT:
Left 55% for headlines. Strong dark editorial background, a controlled diagonal lime brush gesture behind the player, a few ink flecks, generous contrast with readable typography. The large main heading is off-white and the secondary heading is lime; make the date clearly visible. Keep all letters, face, hands and the entire ball inside the canvas with at least 55px margins. Lower thighs may end at the lower composition edge, but no abrupt cut through hands or ball. Footer labels unobstructed, clearly readable. Avoid complex decorative panels, tables, charts, fake statistics or game-score boards.

EXACT TEXT ONLY, verbatim:
Top-left small masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
Below masthead medium large date: 「11/18」
Left dominant first headline: 「試合結果」
Left dominant second headline: 「当日のEFF」
Supporting line below: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Bottom-left footer: 「イラスト（AI生成）」
Beside it: 「イメージ」

No quotation brackets in the artwork. No additional text. No player name or individual performance claim. The random-selected player illustrates the general article topic. Keep the two footer labels exactly as written, without claiming the pose is based on specific recorded performance. Match the confident black-and-lime approved hand-inked illustration aesthetic, never photorealistic.

generator.qa_method: 生成結果の画像表示と保存元PNGのview_imageを確認。文字・日付が固定原稿と一致し、個人情報・個人成績の文字なし。公式写真に基づく短髪・目鼻・唇・短いひげを比較。顔・両手・ボール・全見出し・注記の見切れなし。手の指とボールの保持が自然で、写真風・ロゴ・スポンサー表示なし。
